resources.string: Maintains the real-time Dynamic Island floating overlay and live activities
Dynamic Island overlay & Live Activities running
Required to display the floating Dynamic Island capsule on top of any app using WindowManager TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY.
Required to read active MediaSessions (Spotify, YouTube Music, etc.) and smart notifications from messaging apps.
Required on Android 13+ to keep the IslandOverlayService alive reliably in the background.
Optional permission to detect incoming and ongoing phone call states for the Live Call Island module.
Optional permission on Android 12+ to detect connected Bluetooth audio devices in Live Activities.
Prevents OEM battery savers from terminating the floating Dynamic Island when switching apps.
